{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:A280BlasterRifle-CVD.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]]]]
A '''rifle''' was a type of firearm that was generally larger and more powerful than a [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]]. Rifles could also fire at greater range than pistols, but required the shooter to wield the weapon with both hands in order to use it properly.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Rifles varied in size and power from the popular [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], to the less-used [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|slugthrower rifle]], to the powerful [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]]. Another type of rifle was the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], which was used to fire at targets at long range. Sniper rifles often had a [[bipod]] and [[Scope/Legends|targeting scope]] to aid in targeting at extreme distances.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

[[File:KiSteer1284ProjectileRifle-FF73.png|thumb|left|250px|A [[KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle/Legends|model]] of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] used by [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]]]
Many rifles had a switch that enabled the shooter to switch firing modes from single-shot mode to autofire mode, that is, rapid automatic fire.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> A few rifles were only able to fire in autofire mode such as the [[heavy assault blaster rifle]]<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Some [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifles had a switch that enabled the shooter to switch to a non-lethal [[Stun/Legends|stun]] damage setting, however the range was extremely limited within approximately 9 meters.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />
